messages.text: I need to speak to someone
Handed to the team · Customer asked for a human on first message.

Done, the team has been pinged and one of them will jump into this chat. Stay here if you can, and if you step away you'll get the answer by email.

If you tell me what it's about, I can either sort it now or make sure they come in with the context.
Not being able to see my live feed form my jingleminer lite solo

Most common cause is the miner and your phone or laptop sitting on different networks, so the dashboard can't reach it. Check they're both on the same wifi, then reload the unit's local address. Second most common is old firmware, so grab the latest for your model at harlolabs.com and update.

What does the unit's own screen show right now, hashing or an error?

For hands-on help fastest, our Discord is https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, post there and mention @nullhashrate (JD).
It doesn't have my model on there for an up date
Handed to the team · Firmware/dashboard question on a JingleMiner Lite Solo; no matching build listed

Fair enough, if your model isn't listed there, don't force another build onto it. I've put this to JD, who handles the hardware, and he'll come into this chat.

Fastest route meanwhile is Discord: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, post in the server and mention @nullhashrate, that's JD.

One thing that helps him: what does the miner's own screen show right now, and does it respond if you type its IP into a browser?
